declaration.purpose: deterministic normalized sizing and risk-accounting contract, not real-money sizing

common_risk_audit.cash_notional: actual account sizing is capped by cash, base capacity, symbol capacity and stop-based 1R
common_risk_audit.relationship: Strategy E normalized weights are dimensionless backtest units and do not override or represent account-level Risk V1 sizing

selection.sequence: freeze top-three selection before execution validation; never promote candidate four

sizing.active_policy: divide one exactly among records eligible for standard PnL

exit_risk.fixed_exit: exact 09:34 ET aggregate close under E-D3
exit_risk.invalid_exit_policy: UNRESOLVED_EXIT / INVALID_FOR_STANDARD_PNL; no fallback liquidation or synthetic return
exit_risk.invalid_exit_reporting: E-D6 must report frequency as a risk/data-quality metric

concentration_and_volatility.diagnostic_only: E-D6 may report available sector or volatility metadata without changing decisions

capacity.future_requirement: real-dollar deployment requires position-notional versus liquidity capacity validation
